name: JR Bourne
bio: David J.R. Bourne (born April 8, 1970) is a Canadian actor. He's best known for his roles as Isaac on Mayans M.C., Tom Price on Somewhere Between, Russell Lightbourne VII / Sheidheda on The 100, Kenny Ryan on the drama series Revenge, Chris Argent on Teen Wolf, Martouf / Lantash on Stargate SG-1, and Ray in The Exorcism of Emily Rose (2005). He is perhaps best known in Canada for his appearance in a Molson I Am Canadian television commercial
